parameters.query: WITH cfg AS (SELECT id FROM client_config WHERE slug=$1 AND is_active=true), match_lead AS (SELECT l.id,l.client_id FROM leads l JOIN cfg c ON c.id=l.client_id WHERE $6::text IS NOT NULL AND lower(l.email)=lower($6) AND l.status IN ('replied','booked') ORDER BY l.t_received DESC LIMIT 1), saved AS (INSERT INTO bookings (lead_id,client_id,provider,provider_booking_uid,status,start_time,end_time,attendee_email,attendee_name,event_type,matched_by,payload) SELECT m.id,c.id,'calcom',$2,$3,$4::timestamptz,$5::timestamptz,$6,$7,$8,CASE WHEN m.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'email' END,$9::jsonb FROM cfg c LEFT JOIN match_lead m ON true ON CONFLICT (provider,provider_booking_uid) DO UPDATE SET lead_id=EXCLUDED.lead_id,status=EXCLUDED.status,start_time=EXCLUDED.start_time,end_time=EXCLUDED.end_time,attendee_email=EXCLUDED.attendee_email,attendee_name=EXCLUDED.attendee_name,event_type=EXCLUDED.event_type,payload=EXCLUDED.payload RETURNING id,lead_id,client_id,status), lead_update AS (UPDATE leads l SET status=CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' THEN 'replied' WHEN s.status IN ('created','rescheduled') THEN 'booked' ELSE l.status END,t_booked=CASE WHEN s.status IN ('created','rescheduled') THEN COALESCE(l.t_booked,now()) WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookings b WHERE b.lead_id=l.id AND b.status IN ('created','rescheduled')) THEN NULL ELSE l.t_booked END FROM saved s WHERE l.id=s.lead_id RETURNING l.id), event_log AS (INSERT INTO events (lead_id,client_id,workflow,step,status,detail) SELECT s.lead_id,s.client_id,'booking',CASE WHEN s.lead_id IS NULL THEN 'booking_unmatched' ELSE 'booking_saved' END,CASE WHEN s.lead_id IS NULL THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END,jsonb_build_object('provider_booking_uid',$2,'status',s.status) FROM saved s RETURNING id) SELECT (SELECT id FROM saved) AS booking_id,(SELECT lead_id FROM saved) AS lead_id;
